web-guide-idea-80.audience: Learners interested in Indian folk art and its context.
web-guide-idea-80.offer: A knowledgeable artist teaches a specific technique while explaining its cultural background. Name the tradition accurately instead of treating different styles as interchangeable.
web-guide-idea-80.steps.0: Choose one tradition and explain the motif’s context.
web-guide-idea-80.steps.1: Demonstrate a small composition step by step.
web-guide-idea-80.steps.2: Review participants’ work and suggest further practice.
web-guide-idea-80.equipment: A phone with a close view of the work, paper and the chosen drawing or painting materials.
web-guide-idea-80.returnReason: Explore another motif or composition within the tradition, with deeper context each time.
web-guide-idea-80.promotion: Show your own sample and describe your experience with the specific art form.
web-guide-idea-80.metadataTitle: Warli / Madhubani Art Class — Creator Idea & Practical Guide · avaTOK
web-guide-idea-80.metadataDescription: A knowledgeable artist introduces a folk-art technique and its cultural context. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
